purpose: Teach: 頒布/加味/横行/内職/創始/既得/代用/一掃

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内報の頒布を自ら始められたぞ
lines.en: Father, you took it upon yourself to distribute the company newsletter.
lines.style: Warm, measured admiration. Gentle lift on each accomplishment. Speaking to someone across time — not lecturing, remembering. Quiet pride settling into the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の声を経営に加味された
lines.en: Yes. Father understood how to weave the staff's voice into company direction.
lines.style: Respectful, steady. Not rote — each word chosen carefully, as if honoring a lesson learned by living it. Slight pause before speaking, gathering the weight of what he's saying.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界で偽造が横行した時代に立ち向かわれたぞ
lines.en: Father, you stood against the tide when the industry was drowning in forgeries.
lines.style: Wistful, almost distant. Speaking as if looking at a memory just out of reach. Warm underneath — not mourning, but marking. Slight trailing-off, letting the moment breathe.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはご家族の内職にも理解を示された
lines.en: Yes. Father showed understanding even toward our family's side work during those years.
lines.style: Reflective, tender. Not defensive — explaining a quiet kindness the world might not have seen. Deliberate pacing, each phrase deliberate. Soft gratitude underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、当社の創始者として理念を確立されたぞ
lines.en: Father, as our company's founder, you established a creed we still hold.
lines.style: Reverent and steady. Each word carries the weight of inheritance. Not declamatory — intimate, as if speaking directly to the man himself. Slight emphasis on 'creed,' like it's both anchor and gift.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは既得の特権を捨てて改革をされた
lines.en: Yes. Father gave up his own advantages to drive real change.
lines.style: Solemn, quietly moved. The recognition of sacrifice — not grand, but clear-eyed. Voice steady but warmed by understanding. A small pause before 'gave up,' like choosing the right word matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、希少な原料の代用品を見つけられたぞ
lines.en: Father, you found substitutes for materials no one else could source.
lines.style: Appreciative, almost marveling. Quiet pride in practical ingenuity. Speaking as if recalling something impossible made ordinary by will. Slight wonder underneath the steadiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは不良在庫を一掃する決断もされた
lines.en: Yes. Father made the hard choice to clear out failed inventory and move forward.
lines.style: Wise, grounded. Not heavy — honest. The voice of someone who's learned that difficult decisions can be made without fanfare. Gentle close, like settling something into place.
